slides.title: Real-estate leads don't die in the ad. They die *after the form.*
Where a lead *actually* leaks
slides.sub: Ad → form → call centre → branch sales → site visit.
slides.box: 4 handoffs. Every handoff is a delay, and every delay lets a competitor reply first.

slides.title: Fix 1: answer in *minutes*, not days
slides.sub: Instant WhatsApp to the buyer the moment the form lands.
slides.box: Floor plan + price sheet + two site-visit slots. The call can follow; the first reply can't wait.

slides.title: Fix 2: route it, then *time it*
slides.sub: Leads go by project/area/budget to one owner, not a shared inbox.
slides.box: No call in 15 minutes → automatic alert to the sales manager. Speed becomes a visible metric.

slides.title: Fix 3: tell the ad platform *who visited*
slides.sub: Send site-visit and booking outcomes back as offline conversions.
slides.box: Now campaigns optimise for people who visit, not people who tap "submit".

slides.title: The number to *report weekly*
slides.sub: Cost per lead flatters. Cost per site visit tells the truth.
slides.box: Track by campaign: leads → contacted in 15 min → visits booked → visits done → bookings.
